headline: US Average Gasoline Prices Under Trump Exceed Prior Levels Amid Iran Conflict
summary: Average retail gasoline prices during Donald Trump's second term have surpassed averages from the previous administration, touching $3.472 per gallon amid supply impacts from the Iran conflict.
why: Energy prices and gasoline costs are critical components of consumer inflation expectations and heavily influence broader economic sentiment.

impacts.name: Energy
impacts.why: Geopolitical conflict in the Middle East restricts crude supplies, driving up downstream retail fuel prices.
